subject: SF Customer Summit: session sequencing, speaker handoffs, and pre-read distribution
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Tom Kaplan <tkaplan@orionsys.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft session order + pre-read for SF summit

Team — and Tom, looping you in —

Attached is v1 of the summit pre-read and an initial session roles sheet. Key asks in this note: please confirm (by end of day Monday)
1) which sessions you will own (I put provisional owners in the Roles sheet)
2) any speaker handoffs that require time in the run-of-show (e.g., demo segues, mics, AV)
3) missing context in the pre-read (figures or one-pagers we should add)

High-level sequencing I propose: 09:00 — Welcome & platform vision (15m), 09:20 — Customer success stories (30m), 09:55 — Product deep-dive (40m incl demo), 10:40 — Break, 10:55 — Breakouts (40m), 11:40 — Plenary Q&A and next steps (35m). Room for one panel if Tom wants to surface a customer view.

Attachments: SF_Summit_Pre-read_v1.pdf, Session_Roles_v2.xlsx, Travel_Checklist_SF.pdf

Links: pre-read (drive) below.

Thanks — I want this tidy before travel bookings start next week.

— Priyom

Thanks Priyom — quick notes on sequencing and handoffs:
- I can take Product deep-dive but would like to split the demo with Laura (first 20m Laura demos onboarding flow, next 20m I'll cover performance/cost levers).
- If we do a customer panel, suggest we slot it after breakouts so customers can reference breakout learnings.
- AV note: request a dedicated laptop for the demo + a second clicker so we can handoff without pause. Add this to run-of-show.

I updated Session_Roles_v2.xlsx with my name on Product deep-dive and a proposed handoff minute marker at 10:05.

— Marcus

Thanks — this looks great and timeline works for Orion. Two requests from my side:
1) If you can move the customer panel to after breakouts (Marcus suggestion) that helps; customers want to validate points they hear in small groups.
2) Can you add a 5-minute transition buffer between demo and breakouts for room reconfiguration? We typically need time for breakouts to rearrange seating.

I reviewed the pre-read — the Ops diagram would be very useful. We'll circulate a short one-pager with questions ahead of the meeting.

See you all in SF.
